name: OPPORTUNITY — Gesture Recognition
sensor_type: Body-worn IMUs + object sensors + ambient sensors
placement: 7 IMUs (body) + 12 object sensors (on daily objects) + ambient sensors
channel_description: 113 OPPORTUNITY challenge sensor channels after removing quaternion/orientation and unused columns. Use ADL runs only (not Drill runs).

protocol.note: Use ADL run only. Report mean ± std across all 4 LOSO folds.

description: 4 subjects performed naturalistic morning activities in a sensor-instrumented room. Sensors include 7 body-worn IMUs and 12 object-mounted sensors (attached to doors, drawers, fridge, dishwasher, and other objects), producing 79 channels at 30Hz. Track A targets 17 fine-grained gesture classes (Open Door 1, Open Door 2, Close Door 1, Close Door 2, Open Fridge, Close Fridge, Open Dishwasher, Close Dishwasher, Open Drawer 1, Open Drawer 2, Open Drawer 3, Close Drawer 1, Close Drawer 2, Close Drawer 3, Clean Table, Drink from Cup, Toggle Switch). The task is to segment the stream into 1 second windows with 50% overlap and classify each window into one of the 17 activities. Use the ADL run only. Use Leave-One-Subject-Out cross validation across all 4 subjects. Report mean and standard deviation across the 4 folds.
